item: floor countries ordered by population reached from the operator's dated table; a labelled law-titles sample in twelve languages and its offline measure script; zh/ja topic labels matched as substrings, every hit approximate
summary: v0.6.0 row C (S06-02), the part the session can build offline. R679: within each floor state, countries go by population reached from configs/population_table.json (src.stats.population, absent by default); floor.order states the table's source and as_of, names the countries it lacks (they follow by code) and copies no population figure; with no usable table the order is by code and order.reason says why. Living sources follows the server's order and its note names the table (one key x12). R680 (OPEN_QUEUE 38(d)): in unsegmented languages a label of two or more characters is matched inside a run of text, never across punctuation, every hit approximate (unsegmented_substring); one-character labels are never matched and are counted; measure() sets aside a language no loaded scheme has a label for. The sample: 58 hand-labelled titles, all twelve languages, a no-topic item in each, expected topics named by English preferred label and resolved at measure time (unresolved listed, never loosely matched). NOT done: no measurement, because no thesaurus is built (licence fetch is the operator's; hosts unreachable from the sandbox); the script prints not-measured and exits 3. INT stays on #1717's synthetic fixtures until six UNTC URLs are verified.
